caption_L1: This bar graph is called Global paper production volume from 2008 to 2018 by type (in 1,000 metric tons). There is a linear scale of range 0 to 150,000 along the y-axis, labeled Graphic paper. The x-axis shows Packaging paper and board.
caption_L2L3: From 2008 to 2009 production increased to above 150,000 for the first time. Since then, production has steadily decreased every year, with the production in 2018 being the lowest shown, getting closed to 100,000.
